description: Unit test class for TenantTraceSamplingHandler, verifying the behavior of span tagging based on tenant configuration, certificates, and request parameters in various scenarios.

classes.name: TenantTraceSamplingHandlerTest
classes.description: Test suite for TenantTraceSamplingHandler, covering various scenarios of span tagging based on tenant and request data.

classes.name: EmptyCertificate
classes.description: A mock X.509 certificate class representing certificates with specified subject and issuer principals for testing certificate-based tenant identification.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes mocks, test data, and the handler instance before each test method.

methods.name: testHandleSetsSamplingPriorityForMatchingTenant
methods.description: Tests that requests for tenants with 'trace-sampling-mode' set to 'all' result in setting the sampling priority on the span.

methods.name: testHandleSetsSamplingPriorityForMatchingAuthId
methods.description: Tests that device-specific trace sampling mode 'all' via auth ID triggers span tagging.

methods.name: testHandleSetsSamplingPriorityForMatchingAuthIdInSingleTenantMode
methods.description: Tests span tagging behavior in single-tenant configurations when device auth ID has sampling mode 'all'.

methods.name: testHandleRespectsOverrideForAuthId
methods.description: Confirms that default or overridden sampling modes prevent span tagging when set to 'default'.

methods.name: setupBasicAuthHttpServerRequest
methods.description: Helper to prepare mock HTTP requests with Basic auth headers for tenant and device identification.

methods.name: setupNonSslHttpRequest
methods.description: Helper to prepare mock HTTP request without SSL, to test unauthenticated scenarios.

methods.name: setupClientCertHttpRequest
methods.description: Helper to prepare mock HTTP requests containing a client certificate, used to identify tenants via cert Subject DN.

methods.name: testHandleSetsSamplingPriorityForGivenTenantParam
methods.description: Test span tagging based on tenant parameter when request is unauthenticated and 'trace-sampling-mode' is 'all'.

methods.name: testHandleSetsSamplingPriorityForGivenDeviceParam
methods.description: Test span tagging with device parameter and 'trace-sampling-mode' for that device.

methods.name: testHandleSetsSamplingPriorityForGivenCert
methods.description: Test span tagging with a client certificate associating a tenant with 'all' sampling mode.

methods.name: testHandleSetsSamplingPriorityForGivenCertUsingSubjectDn
methods.description: Test span tagging for a tenant where the cert's subject DN is used as auth ID with 'all' sampling mode.

methods.name: EmptyCertificate
methods.description: Mock X509Certificate implementation returning provided subject and issuer principals, used for certificate-based tenant identification in tests.
